prompt:
Wide 16:9 background illustration for a mystery adventure video game, no characters.
Scene: the second-floor tatami room of an ordinary Japanese house on a hot, bright early-September
afternoon. Sliding glass doors stand open onto a small balcony where freshly washed laundry still
hangs on a pole (a few bath towels, a shirt), stirring in the breeze; beyond it a clear pale sky and
the rooftops of the neighbourhood. Inside, the room is cool and shaded: a woven laundry basket on the
tatami, a small neat stack of folded towels and one bath towel only half folded, a glass of barley
tea on a tray, a smartphone lying face down, a wall air-conditioner. The light from the balcony has a
warm late-summer tangerine (#FF8A3D) tint. Quiet, homely, faintly uneasy. No person, no body, no insect.
Art style: bold graphic-novel illustration, confident black ink linework, flat cel shading with subtle halftone screentone dots in the shadows, limited palette (ink navy #0B0D12, bone white #F2EFE6, cold teal shadows #1B3A44) plus the single accent colour given in this prompt, theatrical lighting, stylish and elegant, quiet, tender and gently mysterious mood, never frightening. Polished key-visual quality for a premium mystery adventure video game.
Composition: the key subjects are kept inside the central 60% of the width so the image can be
cropped to a narrower frame, with clean readable depth and atmospheric perspective.
Strict constraints: NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO numerals, NO writing of any kind, NO captions, NO speech bubbles, NO logos, NO watermark, NO signature, NO frame, NO border.
note: background c08-bg (CASE 01 wasp in the laundry)

very dark navy background (#0B0D12), uniform with no objects, with a soft tangerine orange rim light

edge, the chin about 58% down from the top edge, the head (with hair) about half the image width;
the neck and both shoulders fill the lower part and reach the bottom edge. Facing slightly
off-camera in a gentle three-quarter view, eyes open.

screentone. Scene: a small home garden on a bright summer morning, one year earlier. A woman in a wide straw sun hat and cotton gardening gloves, seen from behind and slightly to the side, kneels by a low flowering shrub with small pruning shears on the ground. She has pulled off one glove and holds up her right hand, looking at it: the back of the hand and the wrist are clearly puffed up and swollen, the swelling tinted tangerine orange (the spot colour, the ONLY colour). A single slender paper wasp flies away into the leaves, drawn in black ink. Calm, a small wince, nothing dramatic.
